title: Captain Feed
subtitle: Daily doses. Scroll, save, mark done.

cards.title: 1% better compounds
cards.body: Tiny daily upgrades beat heroic one-offs. Pick one habit you can finish in under two minutes and protect it like a meeting.

cards.title: W-2 vs 1099 in one line
cards.body: W-2 means the employer withholds tax for you. 1099 usually means you set aside estimated tax yourself. Wrong bucket = surprise April bill.

cards.title: NotebookLM as a study desk
cards.body: Drop PDFs and get grounded answers with citations. Useful for long docs when you need a map before you read cover to cover.

cards.title: Bedrock Guardrails first
cards.body: Before fancy agents, put content filters and topic blocks on the model path. Safer demos, fewer nasty surprises in shared accounts.

cards.title: SSD deal checklist
cards.body: Match capacity, warranty years, and DRAM vs DRAMless. A cheap drive that dies mid-project is not a deal.

cards.title: Short push day
cards.body: Incline push-ups, dumbbell press, lateral raises, overhead extension. Three hard sets each. Leave one rep in the tank.

cards.title: Protect a deep block
cards.body: Schedule one 90-minute focus block with phone in another room. Shallow work expands to fill the day unless you fence it.

cards.title: Standard deduction reality check
cards.body: Most filers take the standard deduction. Itemizing only wins if qualified expenses clearly beat that floor. Keep receipts either way.
